items.title: 75234_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, you were also married to a White woman. [INTERVIEWEE] And that was taboo. Yeah, that was really...

ctx.x: That's why I split from out there. I saw what was happening, and I'd say, "Well, gee, I ain't gonna be out here in this mess, playing... Let me get out of here." Because I wasn't doing anything bad, but I mean, what they thought was bad, it would be anything, you know.
Well, you were also married to a White woman.
And that was taboo. Yeah, that was really...
